---
name: my-skill
description: Use when building or editing any page for The Mad Italian, a wood-fired Neapolitan pizzeria in Lahore, so every page matches its Instagram look, tone and rules.
---

1. Brand name is always "The Mad Italian". Tagline: "Good taste, made with madness." Secondary lines: "For the mad at heart", "Stone baked madness", "From fire to heart".
2. Tone: playful, cheeky and a little unhinged about food. Use mad/madness wordplay, short punchy sentences, and an occasional "Ciaooo".
3. Colours: brick red #B3282D, charcoal black #141010, warm cream #F6EBDD, oven-fire orange #E8782A (accents only).
4. Backgrounds are dark charcoal or brick red. Text is cream. Never use white backgrounds or pastel colours.
5. Fonts: headings in a bold high-contrast serif in CAPITALS (Playfair Display, Google Fonts). Script accents in Yellowtail. Body text in a clean sans-serif (Inter).
6. Every page must include: a header with the brand name, navigation links to all pages, the tagline, both addresses and the phone number in the footer, and the line "Student project, not the official site."
7. Addresses: "49-Z, Phase 3, DHA, Lahore" and "119/E1 Hali Road, Gulberg 3, Lahore". Phone: 0320-8102272.
8. Prices are written as "Rs. 1,450" with a comma for thousands. Dates are written as "23 Nov 2026".
9. Menu categories are Pizza, Pasta, and Panuozzo & Brekky. Describe food in a sensory way (charred crust, bubbling cheese, fresh basil).
10. Layouts must work on a phone screen, with large tappable buttons.
11. Never use pizza clichés like checkered tablecloths, cartoon chefs or the Italian flag colours as decoration. Never write long paragraphs.
